policy_findings.finding: Public course-information browsing is described; watching and studying courses requires login.

Course materials and site content remain subject to intellectual-property and reuse restrictions.

icourse163.policy_conclusion: Browsing a public introduction is distinguishable from production automated aggregation. No blanket prohibition of public human browsing is asserted. This review does not establish authorization for this application automatic metadata integration; runtime remains policy_unreviewed.
